params.name: bank_id
params.description: id of the bank account to be verified

items.docs:
Verify a bank account in order to create a check.

Check the `microdeposit_type` field returned by `GET /v1/bank_accounts/:id` to determine which parameter to submit:
- `amounts` — provide the two microdeposit amounts (in cents) that appeared
  in the bank account statement.

- `descriptor_code` — provide the 6-character code (beginning with `SM`)
  from the bank statement descriptor of the single $0.01 microdeposit.


Submitting the wrong parameter type for the account's `microdeposit_type` wil
Retrieves the details of an existing bank account. You need only supply the unique bank account identifier that was returned upon bank account creation.
Permanently deletes a bank account. It cannot be undone.

params.name: before/after
params.description: `before` and `after` are both optional but only one of them can be in the query at a time.

params.name: include
params.description: Request that the response include the total count by specifying `include=["total_count"]`.

params.name: date_created
params.description: Filter by date created. Accepted formats are ISO-8601 date or datetime, e.g. `{ "gt": "2012-01-01", "lt": "2012-01-31T12:34:56Z" }` where `gt` is >, `lt` is <, `gte` is ≥, and `lte` is ≤.

items.docs: Returns a list of your bank accounts. The bank accounts are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recently created bank accounts appearing first.

Creates a new bank account with the provided properties. Bank accounts created in live mode will need to be verified via micro deposits before being able to send live checks. The deposits will appear in the bank account in 2-3 business days and have the description "VERIFICATION".
